featured.title: Nepal Flood Death Toll Surges Past 330 as Glacier Collapse Scale Becomes Clear

travel.nri_angle: For NRIs traveling to India or buying luggage during visits, Alpine Club offers a branded option at Indian price points well below Western equivalents.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: British Vlogger Says Mumbai’s Taj Is in a ‘Different League’ From Pakistan’s Top Hotels
travel.excerpt: Travel content creator Harry Jaggard compared stays at Mumbai’s Taj Mahal Palace and Karachi’s Pearl Continental, calling Indian five-star hotels comparable to the best in Dubai and the UK.
travel.image_caption: The Taj Mahal Palace Hotel in Mumbai. British vlogger Harry Jaggard called the historic property in a 'different league' compared to luxury hotels in Pakistan.
travel.nri_angle: A viral comparison that highlights how India’s luxury hospitality now rivals the world’s best, relevant to NRIs and diaspora travellers planning trips home.

carousel.title: USCIS Now Checks Green Card Sponsors' Credit History Under Revised Form I-864
carousel.excerpt: A new privacy release in the updated Affidavit of Support lets immigration officers pull sponsors' credit reports directly from consumer reporting agencies.
carousel.image_caption: USCIS now checks green card sponsors' credit history under the revised Form I-864 accepted since August 31, 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian immigrants, who face some of the longest green card backlogs in the world, must now navigate an additional layer of financial scrutiny when sponsoring family members for permanent residence.

carousel.title: India Hosts BRICS Summit This Week With Trade, AI and Payment Systems on the Agenda
carousel.excerpt: The 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on September 12-13 will test whether the expanded 11-member bloc can turn shared interests into concrete economic cooperation.
carousel.image_caption: World leaders pose for a family photograph at the 17th BRICS Summit in Rio de Janeiro in 2025. India hosts the 18th summit in New Delhi on September 12-13, 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: Expanded BRICS payment linkages could reduce remittance costs and trade facilitation measures could benefit Indian-owned businesses across BRICS markets.

carousel.title: 'Dil Chahta Hai' at 25: The Film Nobody Wanted to Make That Changed Hindi Cinema
carousel.excerpt: Farhan Akhtar's directorial debut turned 25 in August 2026 with a cast reunion and the launch of Excel Origins, a new initiative to find the next generation of filmmakers.
carousel.image_caption: Filmmaker Farhan Akhtar, who directed and co-wrote the 2001 coming-of-age classic Dil Chahta Hai, now marking its 25th anniversary.
carousel.nri_angle: Dil Chahta Hai was among the first Hindi films that resonated universally with NRI audiences without needing cultural context; its portrayal of friendship across distance spoke to a generation navigating identity abroad.

carousel.title: Salil Ankola's Journey: From Debuting With Tendulkar to Fighting a Bone Tumour and Severe Depression
carousel.excerpt: The former Indian fast bowler, who played his only Test alongside a teenage Sachin Tendulkar, saw his career cut short by a shin tumour at 28 and has recently spoken about his battle with mental health.
carousel.nri_angle: Ankola's openness about depression resonates with a broader conversation about mental health in the Indian diaspora and challenges the stigma that persists in cricket culture.

carousel.title: India Targets $44 Billion Space Economy as Private Sector Fuels Five-Fold Growth
carousel.excerpt: The country aims to capture 8-10% of the global space market within a decade, backed by 400-plus startups, surging commercial revenues and new satellite broadband ambitions.
carousel.image_caption: An ISRO PSLV rocket at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre launch pad. India aims to grow its space economy to $44 billion by 2033, driven by growing private sector participation.
carousel.nri_angle: India's space boom opens investment opportunities and high-skilled jobs for the diaspora in a sector that barely existed a decade ago.

carousel.excerpt: The asset manager hit the milestone in August, powered by 23 new fund launches in FY2026 and record SIP inflows of ₹16,479 crore — while its group CEO says foreign capital is flowing back.
carousel.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai. Motilal Oswal AMC has crossed two lakh crore rupees in assets under management as foreign investors return to Indian markets.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian diaspora investors watching the FII reversal may find renewed confidence in domestic equity allocations as trade deals and currency stability reshape India's risk profile.
